QuestInfo.name: Hawk's Eyes
QuestInfo.0: With a name like #b#p1101007##k, he's got to have good Insight...right? Find him in #b#m130000000##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p1101007# brags about his keen Insight. It's a little hard to believe, when #p1101007# talks so openly about the other Chief Knights' secrets.
QuestInfo.2: #p1101007# went on and on about his own great Insight and the secrets of the other Chief Knights. Perhaps he wasn't the right person to ask about Insight.

0.0: Oh, looking to learn about Insight? Haha, of course you'd want to talk to me, of course. I'm not called #p1101007# for nothing! Why, I can see through anything with these eyes of mine!
0.1: What's that look for? Don't believe me? Hmph, how disappointing! Fine, I'll prove myself to you. How about this...I'll share with you secrets about the other Chief Knights. But you can't tell anyone! I can trust you, right?

yes.0: Okay, you promised to keep this to yourself, so...let me tell you what I've uncovered about the other Chief Knights...

no.0: Hmm...good point. You don't look like you could keep a secret to save your life.

1.0: Okay, this is a real secret! Don't tell the other Chief Knights that I told you this! Okay, who to start wtih...how about #p1101006#?
1.1: Of all the Chief Knights, #p1101006# is the newest. Before he became a knight, he had a different teacher: #p1052121#! #p1052121# was #p1101006#'s first love...
1.2: #p1101006# keeps a picture of her with him to this day. Oh, but don't tease him about it, or he'll get angry! Remember, you promised to keep this to yourself. Heheheh...

yes.0: What do you think? My hawk eyes can even look through the mask of  #p1101006#! Believe me now? Maybe you'll reach my level someday.
